name: Gods Gift
overview: Scripture reveals that God's gifts are gracious and eternal, given through Christ for salvation and spiritual empowerment. John 3:16 highlights the gift of Jesus Himself, offered so that believers may have everlasting life, while Romans 6:23 and Ephesians 2:8 emphasize that eternal life and salvation are gifts of God received by faith, not earned by works. Additionally, Acts 2:38 shows the gift of the Holy Spirit given upon repentance and baptism, and Romans 12:6 teaches that God distributes diverse spiritual gifts according to His grace. These gifts are irrevocable, as Romans 11:29 affirms, underscoring God’s unchanging purpose and faithfulness in calling and equipping His people.
